: 
G.A., Mohd. Naushad, Noor Ahmed 
 Court No. - 81
Gulzar Ali Alias Badal Malik And 6 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 4 November, 2025
Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/107781516/
1

 Hon'Ble Avnish Saxena, J. 
1.

Sri Wahid Jamal, learned counsel appears for the applicants and submits that the accused-applicant no.1 is husband of opposite party no.2, who has lodged the F.I.R. with contents that she was a divorced lady and was raped by applicant no.1 on false promise of marriage.
She was then married to applicant no.1.
There was mediation agreement between the parties.

The report of mediation is dated 30.04.2024, which was referred for mediation, while disposing of Criminal Misc.
Anticipatory Bail Application Under Section 438 Cr.P.C. No.10002 of 2022, hence the learned counsel seeks interference of this Court to quash the charge-sheet and other proceedings.
2. Learned A.G.A. appears for the State.
3. Sri Raghvendra Singh, learned counsel, holding the brief, appears for opposite party no.2 and admits that the matrimonial matter ended in agreement by way of mediation.
It is settled that the parties will live separately.4.
There is no point in getting the trial continued, when the parties have buried their differences as the star witness would not support the prosecution case.

5. In view of settlement in matrimonial case arrived between the parties in mediation proceedings in pursuance of order of this Court dated 20.12.2022 passed in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application Under Section 438 Cr.P.C. No.10002 of 2022, the charge sheet and the proceedings of Case No.9310/09 of 2022 (State Versus Gulzar Ali alias Badal Malik and others) arising out of Case Crime No.0124 of 2022 undr Sections 376, 323, 504 and 506 I.P.C., Police Station Jhinjhana,District Shamli, pending in the court of Civil Judge (J.D.)/Judicial Magistrate, Shamli are also quashed.

sentences.text: 6. The application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is allowed accordingly.

(Avnish Saxena,J.) November 4, 2025 MN/-
